name: Omamori Midori
source:
A girl in Rie's class who is mischievous, Midori is the lover of Naomi. When Rie accidentally spies Midori and Naomi making love in the school chapel, she gets back at her by turning the girl into her personal plaything.

[from [url=http://www.jlist.com/product/P020]J-List[/url]]
